$comment: Components that `sellbase add <name>` copies into components/sellbase/. registryDependencies are added too.

components.name: theme
components.description: CSS variables every component uses. Import it once in your global CSS.

components.name: product-card
components.description: One product tile with image, title and price.

components.name: product-grid
components.description: Responsive grid of active products, optionally one collection.

components.name: product-carousel
components.description: Horizontal row of products (a collection or the latest), with arrow buttons.

components.name: variant-picker
components.description: Option chips (Talla, Color…) built from the variants; marks sold-out combinations; keyboard friendly.

components.name: booking-picker
components.description: Day and time picker for services, in the store time zone.

components.name: product-detail
components.description: Product page: gallery, variant picker, availability and add to cart.

components.name: product-seo
components.description: schema.org Product/Offer JSON-LD for product pages (search engines show price and stock).

components.name: discount-input
components.description: Discount code field with the server's explanation when a code does not apply.

components.name: cart-lines
components.description: Cart lines with quantity controls and the totals computed by the server (used by cart-drawer and cart-page).

components.name: cart-drawer
components.description: Cart button with count and a side panel with lines, discount code and totals (focus-trapped, Escape closes).

components.name: cart-page
components.description: Full cart page (e.g. /carrito) with lines, discount code, totals and checkout button.

components.name: checkout
components.description: Checkout form: email, address, shipping option, summary and redirect to pay.

components.name: order-status
components.description: Return page after paying (confirming → paid, with the order summary) and "where is my order?" lookup.

components.name: download-page
components.description: Page for download links: file, downloads left, expiry, and friendly expired/used states.
